title: DueCare live demo wheels
subtitle: v0.17.0 live-demo portability bundle with shared DueCare contract and refreshed chat wheel fallback
description: Wheel bundle for the focused DueCare live-demo notebook. The notebook installs from GitHub release/source first, then falls back to local wheels. This bundle includes duecare-llm-chat 0.17.0 for the shared portability contract used across Kernel 01, 02, 03, A-00, and appendix notebooks: /api/portability, model-fit profiles, sample artifact names, knowledge I/O contract, process phases, and graph-edge schema. Legacy infrastructure wheels remain in the bundle for the focused live-demo server stack.
